name: A Delusion in Winterblue
source:
A young man wakes up remembering only his name. Admitted to his employers medical facility he tries to piece together who he is.

[from [url=https://lovexlab.itch.io/a-delusion-in-winterblue]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一名年轻人醒来时只记得自己的名字。他承认自己是雇主的医疗机构，并试图拼凑出自己是谁。

[来自[url=https://lovexlab.itch.io/a-delusion-in-winterblue]itch.io[/url]]
